prompt:
[Animation Style]

3D cartoon rendering in a chibi / Q-version cute aesthetic. Soft subsurface scattering (SSS) on skin for a porcelain-smooth, slightly translucent look. Advanced fur simulation: the black areas of the onesie use short, dense micro-plush fibers; the white belly area uses longer, fluffier pile that deforms and wobbles naturally with body movement. The pale pink scarf has a realistic knit-cashmere texture with fine weave detail. Soft global illumination with a warm-cool contrast — warm key light on the character, cool blue ambient bounce from the snow. Gentle depth-of-field, cinematic but cozy atmosphere. Render quality: high-fidelity CGI, Pixar-adjacent polish, no outline strokes, no flat shading.


[Character Reference]

Reference the character from <图片1>: large brown-red eyes, black blunt bangs bob-cut hair, round face with soft pink cheek blush, small penguin hair clip at the hairline. Full-body black penguin mascot onesie with white long-pile belly fur, yellow beak and round eyes on the hood. Pale pink cashmere scarf wrapped around the neck with the tail end draping naturally. Yellow penguin-flipper shoes. Do NOT use the pure white background or three-view layout from the reference image.

[Subject & Consistency]

A single chibi girl (approx. 2.5 head-body ratio, rounded silhouette) wearing the complete penguin onesie outfit. Maintain the onesie structure, plush material differentiation, pink scarf color, and flipper shoes throughout. Only one character on screen at all times.

[Scene]

A lively night market street after dark, glowing with warm neon and string lights. A row of food stalls with steam rising, colorful lanterns, red paper umbrellas, and glittering fairy lights strung across the alley. The girl walks along the warm-lit street, reflections of neon glowing on wet stone pavement. Light evening breeze, lanterns swaying, steam curling from food stalls.

[Dialogue & Sound Design]

Girl's voice: young, soft, cheerful, slightly breathy child-like voice; speaks in Chinese. Voice stays gentle, cute, and round-toned like a soft baby penguin; the cooing sounds are delivered adorably and naturally, never harsh or loud.

Environment: murmuring crowd, sizzling woks, soft music from stalls, distant chatter.

BGM: cheerful Chinese-style folk tune with guzheng and light percussion, festive and lively, medium volume.

[Timeline — Total 10s]

0.0s – 2.5s — Wandering into the market

The girl waddles into the night market, penguin hood bobbing, and stops in front of a stall where glowing lanterns cast warm red light on her face. She opens her mouth in a big delighted grin as she looks up at a row of swaying lanterns, eyes sparkling.
Girl (excited, adorable): 「咕嘎！咕咕嘎嘎！」
Sound: footsteps on stone, market chatter, a soft clang from a nearby wok, lanterns creaking, cute penguin cooing. Festive guzheng begins.
Camera: low-angle wide shot from behind a stall, warm neon glow, lanterns filling the upper frame.

2.5s – 5.0s — Peeking at the food

She hurries to a steaming food stall and stands on tiptoe to peek at the grill, mouth watering, a big expectant grin spreading across her face as she watches sparks fly from sizzling skewers. She clutches her scarf ends with both flipper hands, bouncing slightly on her flipper shoes.
Girl (gleeful, adorable): 「咕咕嘎嘎～咕嘎！」
Sound: sizzling, hissing steam, a cheerful little coo-giggle, market music swelling.
Camera: medium shot at her eye level, glowing grill light on her happy face, steam curling between camera and character.

5.0s – 7.5s — Playing with the light

She twirls happily in the lantern light, arms spread wide, her pink scarf swirling, laughing openly with a wide joyful smile as the warm glow dances across her black plush fur. She reaches up and pretends to catch a drifting lantern flame with her flipper glove, giggling.
Girl (laughing adorably): 「咕嘎嘎嘎——咕咕嘎！」
Sound: swishing scarf, cute cooing laughter, tinkling wind chimes, festive music peaking.
Camera: slow tracking shot as she twirls, lanterns bokeh in the background, warm glow rim-light her silhouette.

7.5s – 10.0s — A happy farewell

She stands under a string of fairy lights, beaming broadly, and gives a happy wave toward the camera. She hugs her own scarf ends, looks up at the glowing lanterns with a wide proud smile, then turns and waddles off down the lit alley, still grinning.
Girl (content, proud): 「咕嘎～咕咕嘎嘎嘿嘿！」
Sound: footsteps receding, gentle cooing fading, festive music fading, lanterns swaying, soft night breeze.
Camera: low-angle medium shot as she waves, fairy lights twinkling above her, warm neon reflections on wet pavement. Final frame holds on her happy grin as she walks away.

[Consistency Lock]

Keep the girl's identity and count (single character only), penguin onesie material and structure (short black plush + long white belly pile), scarf color and knit texture, flipper-shoe appearance, and the night market scene consistent across all time segments. No extra characters, no costume changes, no style shifts mid-video. Voice remains the same young soft cheerful tone throughout.
